acceptanceCriteria: A decision (or spec amendment) states which inventory decides Spec Kit presence, with a test for a .specify/ holding only excluded files.
body: internal/contextindex/toolchain_status.go decides that a repository uses Spec Kit when at least one admitted source path starts with .specify/. A .specify/ directory holding only excluded or non-indexed files does not count, so specs/<feature>/spec.md falls back to ordinary classification. Question: should presence come from the full tree inventory at the pinned revision? Found in V1-1695 hand-back 2026-10-17.
title: Should Spec Kit presence (STA-V0-007) use the tree inventory instead of admitted sources?
